'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Garrett Larson LS The Signal''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]] · [[The Signal]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:21WRPR2 Larson LS Profit.txt |Download]]
